l.i: Quos summus olim quum veniet Polo
Sed lucis alma quos Iubar excutit,
Non tristis illos vexat opum fames,
Non rem maligna fraude suam expetunt
Non plura poscunt quàm super i manus
Det dulce, donec vile colunt lutum.
Qua nec rubigo, nec timea vorax

page.notes: Several words in the verse are doubtful and not marked with [?] in every case: "Altelte" (line 4), "vinere" (line 18), "æthereis" (line 22) and "timea" (line 23) are uncertain readings. The ligature-like sign before "eniet" in line 1 and the sign before "ile" in line 19 are unclear. The line "super i manus" (line 14) has a doubtful word break.
